about: The Collect for Saint Ubald asks God for help and for the protection of His gracious right hand against all the devil’s wicked designs. It invokes the intercession of the saint as Confessor and Bishop.

seg.tr: Lord, we pray: graciously bestow Your help on us. And through the intercession of blessed Ubald, Your Confessor and Bishop, stretch out over us the right hand of Your favor against all the devil’s wicked designs. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: against all the devil’s wicked designs
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w006: Placatus describes God as favorable in bestowing the help requested.
ex.w007: Impende asks God to bestow help. The object auxilium and the recipients nobis select impendo, rather than the similar-looking verb for hanging over something.
ex.w015: Pontifex identifies Ubald as Bishop in the heading and prayer. It does not make him a pope.
ex.w020: The right hand is an image of God’s active protection over the petitioners. The prayer asks for it against all the devil’s wicked designs.
ex.w024: Your favor describes the protective right hand as God’s propitious or merciful aid.
ex.w042: God describes Christ, the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit. It does not introduce the Father as a new addressee.
